lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Hyah!
Scarlet's slash strikes the torso of a mass-produced Heretic,
but it is abruptly halted mid-strike.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Blast!
She rips the blade free and lashes out wildly.
The Heretic takes every strike in stride and proceeds to fire a beam.
Scarlet barely manages to avoid it, her heart in her throat.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: *Huff... huff...*
The Heretic walks toward her, slow and steady.
The sight ignites her fury.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Mocking me, art thou?!
Scarlet, filled with desperation, charges in.
The Heretic blocks the sword with an arm, then unleashes a beam.
Scarlet tumbles across the ground.
She coughs up blood and uses her sword to push herself up.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Not yet...! The time is not yet upon us...!

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: My blade is forged to cleave all creation!

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: It shall not be stayed by the likes of thee!
She leaps and brings her blade down.
*Thud*
Seeing her sword caught in the Heretic's hands, Scarlet feels a wave of despair.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: By what cause...?
Another beam shoots out, sending her flying backward once again.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Ugh...!

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Why... can I not cleave thee...

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Why?!
Scarlet's mind races as she drifts in and out of consciousness.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Why can I not strike true?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Wherefore do I aspire to cleave?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: So I may grow in might.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: And wherefore do I seek such strength?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Aye, indeed. For my sister.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: To fulfill her dearest wish.

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: Scarlet... you must become stronger.

lines.speaker: janghwa
lines.text: Don't let yourself be controlled... by anyone...

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Rose was strong.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: But how did she come to possess such strength?
Scarlet lifts her head. The mass-produced Heretic has disappeared from her view.
Instead, she sees red petals drifting across the field.
Whether it is real or a hallucination is of little importance.
She gazes at the petals as they drift carelessly in the wind.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: How free...

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: And tranquil...

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Much like Rose.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: She ne'er did hurry, but moved with a grace and bore herself with a spirit unconfined.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: This I conceived,

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: to be strength and beauty.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: I longed to be thus.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Therefore, 'tis plain what course I must pursue.
Scarlet steadies her breathing.
She clears her mind.
The data in her head resets,
and she experiences a slight Mind Switch.
However, in Scarlet's case...

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Pray, is this truly the field of battle?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: And hath my blade ever felt so light in mine hand?
For Scarlet, this Mind Switch is akin to transcendence.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Now, come forth.
The Heretic fires a beam.
Scarlet dodges it effortlessly with a slight twist.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: To parry so grievous a strike would be a fool's errand.
The Heretic closes in, pressing for a melee attack.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: To dodge or parry the strike? A most tricky conundrum.
Scarlet deflects her opponent's incoming fist with the back of her blade,
causing the latter to stagger.
Then gripping Fleetly Fading in reverse,
she drives it into the core of the Heretic.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: No need to waste strength. Strike true at the weakness.
She extracts the blade,
then lowers her stance.
With one clean cut,
the mass-produced Heretic's head tumbles across the ground.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: And victory is assured.
*Clink clink clank*
Dozens of slashes carve the Heretic into pieces,
who then fall lifelessly to the ground.
*Click*
The sword slides into the scabbard.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: A truth so plain... and yet I grasp it but now.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: ... I must render thanks unto mine elder sister. And unto Lilith also.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Scarlet?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Oh, Dorothy.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Is that really you? Did you take that Heretic down by yourself?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Indeed.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Looks like you experienced a Mind Switch.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Methinks so. That raging fire within me hath dwindled to naught.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Do you remember everything?

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Aye, I remember it all.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: I recall full well how oft I did quarrel with thee.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Is adaptation giving thee trouble, perchance? I am calmer than ever, yet methinks thou art not.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Thou shalt adjust in due course. For now, let us attend unto the battlefield.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: Very well. Let's.

lines.speaker: dorothy
lines.text: I'm counting on you, Scarlet.

lines.speaker: hongryeon
lines.text: Ha, such words need not be spoken aloud.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: *Huff... huff...*
Liliweiss, bent at the waist, catches her breath.
She crushes something writhing beneath her foot,
then gazes at the mass-produced Heretics scattered across the ground.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Ugh... Aagh...!
Blood spills from her eyes.
She attempts to wipe it away, but it keeps flowing.
Liliweiss senses the end is near.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: Even in your condition... you took down both of them... alone...

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: Ha... haha... I knew it. You're... my...

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: *Cough cough*

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: Li-Lilith...

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: Seriously... that's enough.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: Rest... now.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: *Cough cough*

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: I still... have work left to do.

lines.speaker: commander
lines.text: Please... just stop...
The Commander loses consciousness.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Commander!
Liliweiss hoists him onto her back.
*Clink*
His dog tag falls to the ground.
Liliweiss struggles even to bend down and retrieve it.
She leaves it behind and sprints toward the entrance of the Ark.
Her whole body screams in protest, but she does not stop.
Liliweiss looks around.
She sees the infirmary.
She starts toward it, then stops.
Most have already entered the Ark, and only a few remain outside.
The Commander's life is in danger,
but this place cannot treat him since it's a facility for Nikkes.
They may be able to buy some time, but that is all.
The Commander will eventually die.
Liliweiss looks at the Commander's face.
Tears threaten to burst forth, but she holds them back.
She quickens her pace,
heading straight for the entrance.
In the midst of the crowd, a soldier recognizes her and makes his way over.

lines.speaker: CGsoldier
lines.text: Major Liliweiss, I'm so glad you're safe.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Hello.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: I'm sorry, but is there an access route for primary personnel?

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: An access route into the Ark.

lines.speaker: CGsoldier
lines.text: What? No, there isn't...
The soldier sees the Commander on Liliweiss's back.
His face has turned a pallid hue, and sweat pours down.
The soldier understands at once.

lines.speaker: CGsoldier
lines.text: ... There is. This way.

lines.speaker: CGsoldier
lines.text: Please don't draw any attention. If others notice, it could cause chaos.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Thank you.
Seeing the masses crowding into the giant elevator, Liliweiss feels an onerous sense of remorse.
She follows the soldier to a smaller elevator meant for ten people.
Three are already inside. Their eyes widen when they see her arrive.
Ignoring the stares, Liliweiss gently lays the Commander down.
She looks at his face for a long while.

lines.speaker: CGsoldier
lines.text: Major...

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Are we waiting for more to arrive?

lines.speaker: CGsoldier
lines.text: ... No. Departing now.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Please take care of him.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Ensure his survival. Can you do that?

lines.speaker: CGsoldier
lines.text: ... Understood.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: I'm counting on you.
Liliweiss steps back.
The soldier takes his place next to the Commander,
as the elevator doors slide shut.

lines.speaker: liliweiss
lines.text: Goodbye...
